steps: Choose a farm map
Select one of eight terrain references or an independent practice landscape. Use a starter scene or blank map, then preview one of 16 editable examples before replacing your layout.
Check the layout
Place crops, buildings and paths, inspect terrain restrictions and coverage, and use undo, selection or move tools. Reference maps do not include every dynamic object or exact game collision.
Share, export or continue
Generate a layout code for a supported built-in reference, or export editable JSON or PNG. Personal screenshots, saves and persistent local projects require the separate private workspace.
example: Place nine crop markers around an iridium sprinkler on an unobstructed practice grid. Turn on water coverage to see which crop cells are reached; the sprinkler occupies its own tile.
faq: Can I plan a Stardew Valley farm layout on mobile?
The canvas supports tap placement, pan and pinch zoom with compact controls. Automated mobile-viewport tests are not physical-device acceptance.
Are these the exact game maps?

The eight terrain references use pinned, game-derived passability, building and tilling flags with independent schematic artwork. They are not original map images or verified live game maps. Separate practice maps and indoor templates are illustrative.
Where can I find Stardew Valley farm layout ideas?

Open map settings and select one of 16 editable examples: twelve farm-reference designs and four original practice layouts. Expand the selected preview to inspect crop coverage and added base building costs before loading. These examples are not exact game layouts or guaranteed optimal designs.
Can I design a farmhouse interior?
Open Indoor designer and choose Farmhouse, then load a cozy or storage example. Furniture uses editable single-tile markers, not exact game furniture dimensions.
Can I optimize sprinkler coverage within a budget?

Choose a sprinkler, available device count, estimated unit cost and budget. Restrict the search to a rectangle or selected crop markers. Small candidate sets use exact enumeration; larger sets return feasible greedy suggestions.
Can I share my farm layout?

Yes. Generate a compact code or public link for a built-in reference or practice map. Supported greenhouse ground changes are preserved. Linked rooms may be included by opting in. Custom terrain and oversized plans require JSON export. Codes do not contain raw saves, screenshots or project names.
How do I plan crop blocks?

Select a crop marker, choose a sprinkler and turn on the irrigation and scarecrow overlays. The reference layouts include modeled watered and protected crop blocks. Check actual terrain, crop eligibility and access in the game.

steps: Choose a room
Select a Community Center room, or search a bundle by the item you need.
Check quantities and quality
Read the required number of candidate slots, quantity and minimum quality before marking a donation.
Review remaining items
Filter incomplete bundles by season and export the checklist.
bundles.example: If a bundle requires any three of five candidates, three fully donated qualifying slots complete it. Partial quantities do not complete a slot.
faq: Do I need every optional bundle item?
No. The required slot count determines completion; some bundles offer a choice.
Are remixed bundles automatically detected?

Saved definitions can be inspected in the private workspace. Positive standard donations merge only if the complete saved definition matches the standard reference; other or remixed definitions require the separate custom checklist.
Can I use remixed Community Center bundles?
Enter the actual game requirements, or review supported save-contained definitions in the private workspace. Confirm donations separately; standard and remixed requirements are not interchangeable.
Can I track remixed bundles from a save?

Merge a supported main save, then load observed definitions in the remixed tracker and confirm the copy. An exact standard definition can independently add positive donations to the standard checklist; unknown and false observations never clear manual progress.

steps: Find a donation
Search artifacts or minerals and narrow by source.
Distinguish discovery and donation
Record an item as found when acquired and as donated only after delivering it to Gunther.
Check rewards and plan a display
Review donation milestones, arrange a practice display grid and export progress.
museum.example: Mark one newly found mineral as Found only. The ready-to-donate count increases but the museum donation total does not. Mark Donated after delivering it.
faq: How many museum donations are tracked?
The reference catalogue contains 42 artifacts and 53 minerals, 95 unique donations.
Does finding an item count as donating it?
No. The tracker keeps these separate; reward eligibility is also distinct from claiming the reward.
Can I arrange museum donations and inspect a saved display?

Group all 95 reference items on an independent practice sheet. In the private workspace, import an exported sheet or inspect positive saved donation tile coordinates. No game room geometry, valid empty display slots or save modifications are inferred.

steps: Choose a prediction model
Start with geode alternatives, Golden Coconuts, Mystery Boxes, special mine floors, Traveling Cart stock or the event calendar.
Set the appropriate inputs
Use the relevant opening counter, game day, randomization mode and conditional switches. The private workspace accepts your own game and farmer IDs locally.
Compare results and conditions
Use target search to compare geode alternatives and a stock-bounded sequence. Check conditional rewards, mine-floor candidates and your museum donations before acting.
predictor.example: With zero geodes previously opened, opening 1 is the first candidate. Compare the five geode types, check Golden Coconut separately, and use the independent Mystery Box count for its three reward scenarios.
faq: Can I enter my own game IDs?
Use the separate private workspace. Its form processes the IDs locally. This PC 1.6.15 model is experimental and lacks independent in-game fixtures.
Do the rows cover every opener?
This model targets Clint’s geode service. Geode Crushers and other container types are outside its scope.
Does the Traveling Cart forecast show the full stock?

No. The reference models ten ordinary random slots, furniture, conditional Rare Seed, seven independent offers and a separately seeded skill-book roll, including optional Night Market and Desert Festival visits. Year 1 Desert Festival guarantee accounting and unknown original guarantee state may affect stock. Fixed goods, precise save-day offsets and independent game fixtures remain outside the model.
Can I predict train times or green rain?
The 28-day calendar shows seeded railroad, green rain and overnight event candidates. Farm state and reload behavior can change actual outcomes.
Does luck affect what comes out of a geode?

For ordinary, Frozen, Magma and Omni Geodes, daily luck and temporary luck bonuses do not change the contents. Luck can affect the chance of finding geodes, which is a separate mechanic. The opening reference uses the game and farmer IDs, opening count, mine progress and applicable randomization settings.
Can I find which geode opening gives a particular museum item?

Choose a museum target and up to 100 opening indices. All five container types are shown as alternative outcomes at each index. Enter available containers for a feasible greedy sequence; do not count multiple alternatives at the same index as simultaneous rewards. Results are reference predictions, not verified actual game outputs.
Can I predict Golden Coconuts, Mystery Boxes and mine floors?

Yes, using the separate reference sections. Golden Coconuts share the geode count; Mystery Boxes use a distinct counter but openings also advance the geode count. Three mystery box scenarios use fixed book and mastery assumptions; skill-dependent rewards are conditional. Dinosaur floors are potential candidates, not guaranteed maps.

steps: Open the private workspace
Only a separately configured workspace can accept a main SaveGame XML file.
Inspect recognized observations
Review the version, main-player fields and recognized collection counts before confirming the local merge.
Review related trackers
Check matched standard bundle donations and collection totals; load recorded professions, XP or earnings in related calculators and export a local backup.
tracker.example: A recognized cooked recipe with a positive count can mark the recipe complete. A missing field does not prove zero completion.
faq: Does a game save leave my device?
The private workspace reads supported fields locally and never uploads the raw file to our server.
Can I track multiple farms?

Yes. The private workspace keeps named farm profiles in separate local databases. Switch profiles before importing another farm; identifiable saves cannot merge into a differently bound profile. Save or export edits first. Farmhands are separate observations, not a shared perfection calculation.
How many steps have I taken in Stardew Valley?
Open the private workspace and choose the main save. Read Steps taken in the observed fields. The value is read from the player's stepsTaken statistic; absent or duplicate records stay unknown.
Can I inspect chest and fridge inventory in my save?

Recognized positive backpack and ordinary chest/fridge quantities in supported saved locations can be reviewed separately in the private workspace. Linked/global containers, machine contents and complete farm inventory are not guaranteed; missing observations do not prove zero stock.
Can I import my farm layout from a save?

Use the farm planner in the private workspace. It can inspect recognized 1.6.x main Farm records, preview compatible building footprints, crop and equipment positions, and report unsupported or conflicting records before applying the partial layout. The save stays on your device.
Can I track special orders, achievements and secret notes?

Open the private save workspace, inspect a supported main save and review recognized positive order, achievement, note and story IDs. Merge to load the latest observations in the perfection view. The public reference checklists do not read private progress. Active-order objective counts are snapshots, not guaranteed current eligibility.

steps: Set season and planting day
Choose an outdoor season, day, available tiles and seed budget.
Compare harvest schedules
Run the planting optimizer and compare per-tile profit, remaining-day profit and seed ROI.
Simulate processing
Enter available machines and cash assumptions to inspect a simplified daily economy.
crop-calculator.example: One parsnip seed costs 20g and sells at 35g normal quality. Planting on day 1 yields a day 5 harvest and 15g net before other costs.
faq: Which crop is most profitable?

It depends on day, available seeds, budget and regrowth. Compare 34 shop-price reference crops, opt in to Year 2 or Oasis stock, and use the separate owned-seed calculator for limited seeds and Powdermelon.
Do these results include fertilizer or random extra yields?
Growth fertilizer and fixed quality are explicit inputs. Guaranteed base yields exclude random extras; the expected-quality scenario is separate.
Are the results expected-quality profits?

The default optimizer uses guaranteed base yields. The separate quality scenario ranks eligible crops by expected per-tile profit. The daily processing ledger uses fixed harvest quality and approximate day timing.
What are the most profitable greenhouse crops?

Compare a protected growing window of up to 112 days, with your actual soil tiles, budget and seeds. Ancient Fruit and other limited seeds use a confirmed stock count; shop-price rankings assume available stock.
Can I reinvest crop sales into more seeds?

Yes, in separate protected and outdoor daily scenarios. Next-day receipts fund planting; available seed supply, shared land and processing capacity constrain the outdoor scenario. Four planting priorities are compared with and without processing; the best tested policy is not a proven global optimum.
Can I plan a full outdoor year?

The annual rotation optimizer models normal outdoor season boundaries and cross-season crops with an upfront shop-seed budget. Winter Powdermelon uses a separately limited owned seed stock. Small allocation problems are solved exactly under the stated raw-profit assumptions; larger scenarios may return a bounded feasible solution.
Does the outdoor planner compare processing with raw sales?

It compares four planting priorities with raw sales and optional shared processing equipment. Daily receipts settle the next morning, seed supply is finite, and the best tested result includes a raw-only fallback. It assumes compatible user-defined recipes and does not model every game rule.
Can I compare several processing devices and wine aging in one season?

Yes. The daily economy uses shared raw stock, available kegs, jars, dehydrators, user-confirmed mill throughput and accessible casks. Set the processing tail and wine quality target. The fixed planting schedule and greedy dispatch are not a global optimum.

steps: Enter actual sale values
Choose a category, quality and actual sale value for each of up to nine items.
Optimize available candidates
Enter candidate quantities to find the highest-scoring feasible display under the reference formula.
Apply and review
Apply the suggested selection, inspect category and item points, and adjust manually.
fair-calculator.example: One active normal-quality item worth 400g earns six item points. Without a recognized category bonus the displayed reference score is 14 − 7 + 6 = 13.
faq: How many points win first place?
The reference model uses 90 points for first place.
Can I reuse an item in the recommendation?

Only up to the candidate quantity. The private workspace can populate recognized positive backpack and optional ordinary chest/fridge candidates; manually confirm actual sale prices, categories and stock.
What items help win the Stardew Valley Fair?

The reference candidate library offers one example per recognized category. Six different categories maximize the variety bonus; nine occupied slots and strong item scores can reach the 90-point first-place threshold. Confirm actual price, quality and quantity.

steps: Search fish collection
Search names and recorded acquisition conditions.
Filter recorded conditions
Select main-route season, location, listed time, weather or crab-pot sources. Unspecified conditions remain explicit.
Export missing progress
Review incomplete fish and export the collection record.
fishing.example: Filter by spring and search for a fish name; total collection progress remains independent of the visible list.
faq: Does this list include Legendary Fish II?
No. The reference collection excludes challenge-only legendary variants.
Are all weather and bait alternatives modeled?
No. The current hints describe common routes; exact weather, time and bait coverage is incomplete.
How much do fish sell for in Stardew Valley?

Compare all 72 collection entries using the listed normal, silver, gold or iridium quality where applicable and the Fisher or Angler profession. Other catchables do not receive fish profession bonuses. The comparison uses standard price references, not world margin settings.
Are alternate fish locations included?

Each collection card has a detailed reference with location, time, season and weather where listed. Special bait, fishing level and location unlocks can affect results; the main-route filter is not an exhaustive catchability engine.

steps: Record known category counts
Enter verified completion for each category; leave unobserved categories unknown.
Inspect the weighted range
The lower bound counts only recorded values; the upper bound allows full completion of unknown categories.
Review missing goals
Use the related collection trackers and load saved manual counts in the private workspace.
perfection.example: 77 of 154 shipping entries contribute 7.5 of 15 percentage points under the reference formula. Unrecorded categories remain unknown.
faq: Does this calculate exact in-game perfection?

It is a proportional reference estimate with explicit unknowns. The separate multiplayer calculator uses the highest individual completion in each player-specific goal. In-game display rounding and save-data completeness still require independent verification.
What do waivers cost?
The reference calculator uses 500,000g per waiver point and caps the final score at 100%.
Does the tracker calculate multiplayer perfection?

Yes, the separate team calculator combines the highest count for each player-specific goal and counts shared farm goals once. In the private workspace, saved player observations are conservative minimums; no unknown count is assumed complete.
How do monster eradication goals affect perfection?
All 12 reference Guild goals must be complete for the monster component. Enter counters or load recognized per-player save statistics.
How can I find what I still need for perfection?

Review the goal-gap table and open the individual collection checklist for shipping, fishing, cooking or crafting. Local positive completions are marked as recorded; items without a positive record remain unconfirmed, not necessarily missing. Manual category counts do not mark individual items complete.
How are alternative Stardrop records treated?

The level-100 mine chest-consumed marker can confirm that reference source without double-counting the mail flag. A maximum-stamina completion flag is displayed separately; it does not identify every source or override the conservative score.

steps: Find a recipe
Search crafting recipes and distinguish learned from crafted.
Set batch quantities
Select how many crafting batches you plan and inspect required direct materials.
Compare inventory
Enter owned materials and optional prices; export the shortages and ingredient plan.
crafting.example: For two identical crafting batches, every direct ingredient quantity is doubled. Output quantity may be greater than two if a recipe produces multiple units.
faq: Does learning a crafting recipe count toward completion?
No. The item must actually have been crafted.
Are profession substitutions expanded?
The standard recipe list does not automatically apply every profession or recursive ingredient substitution.
How do I unlock missing crafting recipes?

Filter the 149 standard reference recipes by skill level, mastery, shop, friendship, quest or milestone. Select an item reference for conditions that depend on game state. Wedding Ring is outside the single-player checklist.
How does Trapper change the Crab Pot recipe?
With Trapper selected, each planned Crab Pot uses 25 Wood and 2 Copper Bars instead of 40 Wood and 3 Iron Bars.

steps: Find an item
Search the reference shipping collection.
Mark actual shipping
Record completion after the relevant in-game shipping action rather than merely acquiring an item.
Export the checklist
Filter incomplete entries and export the record.
shipping.example: Finding a Parsnip alone does not complete the shipping entry; mark it complete after the relevant shipping action.
faq: How many items are tracked?
The reference target is 154 produce and forage shipping entries.
Does every sale count?
No. Selling to a shop and the collection's shipping condition are not necessarily equivalent.
How do I find missing shipping items?
Filter incomplete entries by category or common acquisition season, then export the missing list with source hints. Owning or selling to a shop does not confirm shipping.

steps: Search the recipe list
Find a dish by name or ingredient.
Set batches
Enter the number of meals to cook and inspect direct ingredients.
Plan missing ingredients
Compare stock with requirements and record dishes actually cooked.
cooking.example: Two Fried Egg batches require two eggs. Owning the recipe alone does not complete the cooking record.
faq: How many cooking recipes are listed?
81 reference recipes are included.
Does the ingredient planner recursively expand dishes?

The separate expansion view recursively expands supported intermediate dishes and can deduct intermediate stock once. The direct material view stays separate, and unresolved ingredient groups require manual confirmation.
How do I learn missing cooking recipes?
Filter all 81 entries by TV, friendship, skill level or shop. Queen of Sauce entries include the reference first broadcast date; the cookbook also teaches these recipes.
Can I calculate ingredients for Complete Breakfast from scratch?
Yes. The separate expansion view includes Fried Egg, Hashbrowns and Pancakes; enter intermediate stock if you already have these dishes. Direct inventory and cost estimates remain separate.
Can I use large eggs, goat milk or existing dishes?
Choose a concrete accepted egg, milk or selected fish for direct grouped ingredients. Intermediate stock is deducted once in the separate expansion view. Unresolved groups remain manual.

steps: Choose a region
Review the listed sources and reveal puzzle hints only when needed.
Record collected walnuts
Record fixed rewards and repeated sources separately.
Compare upgrade costs
Use the balance ledger; lifetime walnuts and spendable balance are different.
golden-walnuts.example: If you have found 30 lifetime walnuts and spent 10, the available balance is 20 under that manual ledger.
faq: How many Golden Walnuts are in the reference target?
130 total. The manual tracker separates repeated drops and fixed tasks.
Does the tracker locate every walnut from a save?
No. The current source descriptions and counts do not reconstruct exact game positions or all save events.
Can I load collected walnuts from my save?
The private workspace supports positive markers from recognized saved walnut fields. Ambiguous task matches are omitted; lifetime count and upgrades are separate from the manual checklist.
Are all walnut task groups mapped?

The 69 reference task groups have marker, counter or flag mappings. This does not verify all real save structures or reconstruct exact in-game map positions; unsupported or ambiguous observations remain unknown.
Does the map show all actual walnut locations?

Known tile markers are plotted on independent coordinate grids by game map. Other tasks have location and puzzle guidance; the plot is not a terrain or navigation map. Lifetime and golden-parrot markers are separate from individual completed tasks.

steps: Compare farm types
Select two farms to compare Wiki estimates and base reference diagrams.
Switch reference layers
View access, buildability or tillability independently; sort all eight in the pinned terrain table. These flags can overlap and are not current planting capacity.
Open an editable layout
Choose a matching starter map, practice map or farm-specific layout example. The private workspace only preselects a linked example until you explicitly load it.
farm-comparison.example: Compare Standard with Beach using the reference tillable counts, but remember that beach sand and terrain constraints limit sprinkler use.
faq: Which farm has the most tillable tiles in the reference table?
Standard has 3,427 listed tillable tiles.
Are the linked maps exact farm maps?

The planner provides eight functional terrain references and independent practice landscapes. Neither contains official game imagery. Reference terrain flags do not guarantee exact current-version gameplay or dynamic obstacle positions.
Which farm is best for my playstyle?

Compare all eight choices: Standard for large planting areas, Riverland for fishing, Forest for forage, Hill-top for mining, Wilderness for combat, Four Corners for zoning, Beach for non-sandy crop space and other production, and Meadowlands for livestock. Recommendations are qualitative.
Why are Wiki counts different from the terrain-mask table?

The Wiki table lists reference estimates and additional buildable area. The independent pinned mask table counts flags over the full grid, including margins and obstacles; buildable and tillable can overlap. Neither is exact available acreage in your save.
Can I compare a Hill-top, Riverland or Four Corners layout?

Yes. Compare their characteristics, select their terrain reference and open the farm-specific editable example. Eight farm types are included; these designs do not reproduce official artwork or dynamic obstacles.

steps: Enter earnings and levels
Enter lifetime earnings, total skill levels and friendships.
Confirm milestones
Select only confirmed in-game achievements; Community Center completion and ceremony are distinct.
Check candle threshold
Inspect the score and remaining points to four candles.
grandpa-calculator.example: A lifetime earnings input of 1,000,000g contributes seven income points in the reference calculation.
faq: How many points earn four candles?
At least 12 reference points.
Can I load a save?
In the private workspace you can explicitly load recognized earnings and skill XP-derived levels; remaining achievements are manual.

steps: Enter experience
Record XP for each of the five skills or load observed main-player XP in the private workspace.
Compare thresholds
Inspect level, XP to next level and profession branches.
Track mastery separately
Record mastery points independently; export or save local progress.
skills.example: At 15,000 skill XP, the reference threshold table reports level 10.
faq: How many base skills are there?
Five: Farming, Mining, Foraging, Fishing and Combat.
Does the tool award professions in game?
No. It models thresholds and shows branches, without writing to the original save.
Does the save record mastery XP?
A supported save can contain the player's MasteryExp statistic. Load it alongside skill XP; absent values remain unknown and are not extrapolated from total XP.
Can I see my actual saved professions?
A recognized main-player profession ID list can display recorded vanilla choices. Other farmhands' recognized choices are shown separately in the save inspection. Unknown records stay unknown.
